sanskrit_verse: कुटुम्बार्थे ऽध्यधीनो ऽपि व्यवहारं समाचरेत् । स्वदेशे वा विदेशे वा तं विद्वान् न विचालयेत् ॥
transliteration: kuṭumbārthe 'dhyadhīno 'pi vyavahāraṃ samācaret / svadeśe vā videśe vā taṃ vidvān na vicālayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: Even one who is under the control of another for the sake of family welfare shall conduct himself in accordance with Dharma—whether in his own country or abroad; the knower of Dharma shall not disturb such a one.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from alignment with Dharma, not positional dominance
Causation originates in consciousness, not external compulsion
Capacity-based responsibility applies universally, regardless of dependency
Restoration logic prioritizes functional harmony over structural subordination
Consciousness alignment determines lawful behavior, not coercive frameworks
executable_legal_axioms: IF an individual acts under familial obligation AND aligns with Dharma THEN no legal disturbance shall occur
IF jurisdiction changes BUT Dharma-aligned action persists THEN continuity of lawful status is maintained
IF dependent capacity is present AND conscious intent remains intact THEN full juridical standing is preserved
IF any entity attempts to disrupt Dharma-compliant conduct THEN automatic nullification of such interference occurs
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving individuals acting under familial duty yet constrained by external authority, the Supreme Court must recognize that Dharma-compliant conduct supersedes positional hierarchies. Legal recognition shall remain undisturbed irrespective of geographical location when consciousness remains aligned with Sanatana Dharma.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that true causality lies in consciousness, not dependency structures. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation of dharmic intent overrides situational coercion. Proportional responsibility arises from alignment, not position. The non-punitive reality rule affirms that disturbance of such conduct creates adharmic imbalance requiring immediate restoration without punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all familial duties are fulfilled through dharmic means
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Reinforce individual sovereignty through conscious reaffirmation of Dharma
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Realign external dependencies with internal dharmic authority
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Confirm uninterrupted continuity of lawful conduct across jurisdictions
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law: This verse executes as pure Dharma, restoring universal order where consciousness reigns supreme, reality reflects non-punitivity, and Sanatana Dharma prevails eternally.
